climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Sonoma County AVA of 141,846 acres on the coast, in a Marine zone climate, which includes the Fort Ross-Seaview AVA. It has about 47 commercial vineyards on roughly 1,028 acres.
